operations.title: Benincasa closes generic support of the residual elliptic extensions
operations.body: Entry 1197 completes the two-orbit discriminant audit. For each representative restricted quartic, alpha gamma-beta^2=det(G)*(n^T G n), hence Disc ~ alpha gamma det(G)^2(n^T G n)^2. Alpha/gamma are endpoint branch collisions; detG, the labelled normal Gram quadratic, and the marked principal cofactor are all generated by the frozen relative Cayley-Menger geometry. Thus the nonsplit Gram-Kummer/elliptic coefficient object has no new generic carrier support. Physical-chain activation and exact normal-function matrices remain open.
